A related but DIFFERENT covalently-bonded N8 species ('diazidyldiazene', charge-separated +/-0.3, studied in ref 5 of this paper) is mentioned but not detailed here either. Low priority / thin data.

species.method: MP2/6-31G(d) geometry (from ref 41); single-point CCSD(T)-fc/aug-cc-pVDZ, CCSD-fc, MBPT(2)-fc scan (Figure 3, this paper)
species.notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT explicitly stated by the authors: 'N5-radical is not a minimum at all levels of theory' -- they could not find a minimum at RI-MP2-fc/TZVPP; CCSD and CCSD(T) energies fall MONOTONICALLY with increasing N2-N3 distance (i.e. the ring/chain simply dissociates, no barrier/minimum at their best levels), while only the lower-level MBPT(2) shows a shallow minimum near N2-N3~1.52 A, which the authors themselves suspect is a spin-contamination ARTIFACT of UHF-based MBPT2/MP2. They explicitly say they 'interpret the geometry of ref 41 as a point on the dissociation path', NOT a genuine minimum. RECOMMENDATION: exclude this from the confirmed-minima list, or include only with a prominent flag that its status as a real minimum is actively disputed by the source paper itself.
